question: National Swimming Association of India was founded in __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1949**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **National Swimming Association of India** was founded in the year **1949**. It marked the establishment of the official governing body for swimming in India. 
• The association was created to promote swimming as a competitive sport and to oversee its development across the nation. 
• The governing body was responsible for organizing national-level swimming competitions, formulating rules, and selecting athletes for international events. 
• It also worked towards nurturing talent in swimming and enhancing the skills of swimmers through training programs and coaching initiatives. 
• Being established in **1949**, the association played a key role in laying the foundation for swimming as a professional sport in India. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **History of Swimming in India:** 
• Swimming as a sport gained prominence in India during the early 20th century, with the establishment of clubs and local competitions. 
• The creation of the National Swimming Association of India in **1949** provided a structured framework for the sport's growth. 
• India has produced several accomplished swimmers who have represented the country in international events like the Olympics and Commonwealth Games. 
• **Key Functions of the Association:** 
• The association is responsible for maintaining a standardized set of rules for swimming competitions in India. 
• It also handles the certification of swimming coaches and officials to ensure professionalism in the sport. 
• Selection of athletes for participation in international events is one of its major roles. 
• **Development Initiatives:** 
• The association has introduced training programs to enhance the skills of swimmers and improve their competitiveness. 
• Initiatives to promote swimming among youth include organizing camps and grassroots-level competitions. 
• **Notable Achievements:** 
• Indian swimmers have won medals in regional competitions such as the Asian Games and South Asian Games. 
• The association's efforts have led to the establishment of modern swimming facilities in urban and semi-urban areas. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Swimming as a Sport:** 
• Swimming is one of the most popular sports globally and is included in major international events such as the Olympics and World Championships. 
• Competitive swimming involves various styles, including freestyle, backstroke, breaststroke, and butterfly. 
• **International Affiliations:** 
• The National Swimming Association of India is affiliated with the **International Swimming Federation (FINA)**, which governs swimming worldwide. 
• FINA provides technical guidance and facilitates participation in international events. 
• **Role in Promoting Fitness:** 
• Swimming is considered one of the best activities for overall physical fitness and mental well-being. 
• The association has also promoted swimming as a recreational activity for people of all age groups. </ul
